title: 2 panels 2 different fabrics, colors and backings
text:
2 panels 2 different fabrics, colors and backings. I ordered 2 panels of different lengths in the same natural color but... Lovely pattern stamped on 2 different fabrics that flamingo P must consider close enough. One a slightly brighter gold than the other and each had completely different backings. One was a shiny, satin backing the other was simply the back side of the fabric.
This is another retailer of drapes that seems to be peddling irregulars without informing their customers. Never again. This isn't my first bad experience with drapes. I wish it was. I sent both back, of course. They are useless if you need more than 1. They are sent in separate boxes, perhaps to discourage returning them all.
